Hi Sophie — thanks for sending this over and for the call. Redwood is very interested; a couple items we'd like to adjust before we can sign: 

1) Speaking slot: Can you confirm availability for a 40-minute panel on Day 2 (afternoon)? We'd prefer a case-study slot with product demos (30 mins) + 10 mins Q&A.
2) Booth: We need a 10'x20' island or a double 10'x10' directly adjacent to sponsor partner AcmeCloud — can you guarantee adjacency?
3) Logo placement: Gold tier has logo in program and website footer. For our use case we need logo in the program front spread and on the main stage slides (visibility to 1000+ attendees). Is that possible without upgrading to Platinum?
4) AV & Demo: We require a dedicated A/V tech during our session and a wired LAN drop for live demos. Include pricing for on-site A/V support if not included.
5) Payment terms: Our procurement requires Net 45 and an itemized invoice with PO line support.

If you can accommodate the above, we can proceed before the early-bird deadline. I copied Lauren (Field Marketing) and Karthik (Head of Partnerships) for budget/placement confirmation.

Thanks,
Ava Chen
Field Marketing Manager | Redwood Inference
ava_chen@redwood.ai

Quick internal note before we send a formal counter:

- Budget: We've got $45k carved for H2 events (confirmed with finance). Gold package at list plus add-ons should fit if we get adjacency and extended visibility.
- Speaking: Karthik, can your partner relationships team lock a 40-minute case-study slot? If program team won't allow, propose a 30-min main-stage + 25-min workshop the next day.
- Legal: We need the sponsor contract to remove language that gives the organizer rights to use our logo for promotional materials beyond the event program without approval. Also add a clause for logo approval within 5 business days of asset submission.
- Procurement: Net 45 is non-negotiable for us; we can provide PO by 2026-05-05.

I'll let Ava coordinate the counteroffer to Sophie. Marissa — flagging this in case there are cross-promotional commitments we should avoid (we have an AcmeCloud co-marketing schedule in Q3).

Lauren Bishop
Senior Director, Field Marketing
lauren_bishop@redwood.ai

From: Sophie Turner <sophie.turner@cloudforum.org>
To: ava_chen <ava_chen@redwood.ai>
Cc: sponsors@cloudforum.org, Evan Brooks <evan@eventops.co>
Date: Mon, 20 Apr 2026 16:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Cloud Inference Forum — 2026 sponsorship packages (Booth + Speak)

Ava — really appreciate the clear asks and the logo package. I checked with the programming and logistics teams:

- Speaking: We can reserve a 40-minute case-study panel on Day 2 (14:00-14:40) pending final speaker list.
- Booth adjacency: We can guarantee a double 10'x10' (10'x20') directly adjacent to AcmeCloud — I'll note that in the floorplan.
- Logo placement: We'll upgrade the pack to include "front-spread program" placement and placement on the "main stage sponsor slide" for Gold at no additional cost if you commit by 2026-05-03.
- AV & Demo: Dedicated A/V tech with one wired LAN drop is an additional $1,500 (one-time). On-site tech coverage is included for the session if you confirm by 2026-05-03.
- Payment terms: We usually run Net 30. Our finance team can accept Net 45 for Redwood for this year; please include a PO and we'll issue a Net 45 invoice.

I'll attach an itemized quote and a revised sponsorship agreement with the logo-approval language and an asset-deadline addendum. If the above looks good, I'll send a DocuSign link.

Best,
Sophie
